whereby, the learned Sessions Judge rejected the discharge application filed by the present applicant.
2. Rule, returnable forthwith.
Learned Additional Public Prosecutor waives service for the respondents - State. 2.1
Considering the issue involved in the matter and with the consent of the learned advocates for the parties, the matter is heard finally today.

3. Outlined facts of the case of the applicant is that an FIR being C.R. No. 11196010230003 of 2023 came to be registered with the DCB Police Station, Vadodara City for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 465, 467, 468, 471 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC) and Sections 4(3)
and 5 of the Gujarat Land Grabbing (Prohibition) Act, 2020 against accused persons named therein,
in which, Charge-sheet came to be filed on 15.02.2023, NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.RA/618/2025 JUDGMENT DATED: 02/03/2026 undefined wherein, the present applicant came to be shown as Witness No.
38.

It is stated that subsequently, a supplementary Charge-sheet came to be filed on 04.03.2023,
wherein, the present applicant is shown as Witness No. 39.
Thereafter, another supplementary Charge-sheet came to be filed on 23.05.2023, wherein, the present applicant is arraigned as accused No. 8.
Accordingly, the applicant preferred an application under Sections 239 r/w. Section 227 of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 (the Code) for discharging the applicant from the offence in question.

The said application came to be rejected, as aforesaid, by the learned Sessions Judge,
being aggrieved of which, this revision application has been filed by the applicant.
4. Heard, the learned advocate for the applicant and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondents - State. 4.1

The learned advocate for the applicant, drawing attention of the Court to the impugned order, more particularly, paragraph 4 onward thereof, would submit that no reasons whatsoever have been assigned by the learned Sessions Judge while passing the NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.RA/618/2025 JUDGMENT DATED: 02/03/2026 undefined impugned order and coming to such a conclusion of rejecting the discharge application.
It is submitted that the learned Sessions Judge has cursorily observed in the said order that a prima facie case and involvement of the applicant is made out.

It is submitted that, however, the learned Sessions Judge has not given any reasons as to what was weighed with him and as to what prima facie evidence is there against the present applicant so as to frame the charge against the present applicant.

Thus, in the submission of the learned advocate for the applicant, the learned Sessions Judge has materially erred in not considering the evidence on record and the Charge-sheet papers which could be evident from the unreasoned order itself.
Accordingly, it is urged that this application may be allowed setting aside the impugned order herein.

5. As against this, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondents - State, while supporting the impugned order, would submit that the trial Court, after considering the material on record, has recorded the reason to the effect that a prima facie case is made out against the present applicant and hence, no NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.RA/618/2025 JUDGMENT DATED:
02/03/2026 undefined interference is called for by this Court in the revisional jurisdiction at this Tushar Prakashchandra Modi vs State Of Gujarat on 2 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111858692/
2 stage in the case on hand and eventually, it is prayed to reject this application.
6.

sentences.text: Having regard to the submissions canvassed and upon perusal of the impugned order, more particularly, the reasoning part, wherein, it is observed by the learned Sessions Judge that considering the D.E. List as well as the statements of the witnesses as well as the facts of the complaint, the complainant has registered his complaint on 20.01.2023 before the DCB Police Station, in which, the Investigation Officer has filed the Charge- sheet and considering the documentary evidence, involvement of present applicant namely Tushar Modi is surfaced.

Thereafter, only referring to a decision of the Apex Court and without even making any whisper about the documents or without making prima facie observations qua the documents which weighed with the learned Sessions Judge, the learned Sessions Judge came to such a conclusion and observed that a prima facie case is made out against the present applicant and thus, rejected the discharge application of the applicant.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.RA/618/2025 JUDGMENT DATED: 02/03/2026 undefined 6.1

Thus,
it appears that the impugned order is non-speaking one and without assigning any reasons.
Accordingly, on that ground only, this application deserves consideration and the matter is required to be remanded back to the learned Sessions Judge for fresh consideration.
7. In view of the above, this application succeeds and is accordingly, allowed.

The impugned order,
as referred to herein above, is set aside.
The matter is remanded back to the learned Sessions Judge for deciding the same afresh.

7.1 It goes without saying that this Court has not entered into the merits of the case and the trial Court concerned shall decide the application for discharge afresh after giving due opportunity to both the sides, on its own merits, in accordance with law,
uninfluenced by the earlier order as well as by this order, and shall pass a detailed order with proper reasoning.
Rule is made absolute, accordingly.
